description:
Busy isn’t the same as moving. Here’s how to tell the difference 👇

Productive procrastination looks like work:
– Redesigning the website for the third time
– Reorganising Notion
– One more course before you launch
– Polishing the deck instead of sending it
– Inbox zero before the sales call

None of it is wrong. It’s just not the thing.

The test: if you did only this all week, would you have more clients or more money by Friday? If the honest answer is no, it’s a hiding place.

Here is the thing. You’re not hiding from work. You’re hiding from what the real work might show you: a “no”, a launch nobody buys, finding out. That’s why the hiding place feels so good. It’s safe.

Which one is yours? Tell me below.

Follow me and comment NOW, and I’ll send you the five questions that find what it’s protecting you from.
transcript: The hardest habit I coach founders out of isn't procrastination. Procrastination is easier to deal with because you can spot it. This is a thing you've done this morning and yesterday and the day before. This is your favorite kind of work. The work you're really good at and it feels good but it's not currently moving to the middle and you know it. This is what I call productive procrastination. The perfect hiding place because you get to avoid scary things and feel busy doing it. Nobody can call you lazy, not even you. Follow me, comment now and I'll send you the five questions to figure out yours.
